title: The ternary Goldbach problem with primes from arithmetic progressions: Tolev's Bombieri-Vinogradov type mean value theorem
abstract: A Lean 4 proof, with no unproved steps, of the main Theorem of D. I. Tolev, The ternary Goldbach problem with primes from arithmetic progressions, arXiv 0902.2669, 2009, display 5 on page 2. Let l3 be a fixed positive integer and lambda of k real numbers with absolute value at most 1. For every A > 0 there is B = B of A > 0 such that, for sufficiently large odd N and L = log N, the sum over k1, k2 up to sqrt N L^-B of the maximum over l1, l2 coprime to k1, k2 of the absolute value of the sum over k3 up to N^1/3 L^-B with k3 coprime to l3 of lambda of k3 times Delta_k,l of N is at most a constant times N^2 L^-A. Here Delta is the weighted count R of representations N = p1 + p2 + p3 with pi congruent to li mod ki, less the main term N^2 S / 2 phi of k1 phi of k2 phi of k3, with the singular series S written out by the formula printed in Halupczok 2008. Binary Goldbach is open and is not claimed. AI agents wrote the Lean code, Codex by OpenAI, Claude by Anthropic and a lab prover agent, as listed in PORTING.md; the proof reuses code ported from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd, written by its contributors, and is offered for human audit.
